Annotators compare models by answering which one performs better (or tie) on fluency, empathy, identification, suggestion, and overall support effectiveness.

The annotators are asked to choose which one performs better (or select tie) in terms of the following metrics: (1) Fluency: which model generates more fluent and understandable responses; (2) Empathy: which model has more appropriate emotion reactions, such as warmth, compassion and concern; (3) Identification: which model explores the user's situation more effectively to identify the problem; (4) Suggestion: which model offers more helpful suggestions; (5) Overall: which model provides more effective emotional support overall.
